text:
Sunita Rao: hey all, Sunita here — starting today on Platform. Happy to be here! Quick setup q's: 1) Is the MDM laptop already en route? 2) who do I ping for SSH access to infra boxes? 3) any desk plant allergies i should be aware of? Also, two-truths-one-lie to break the ice: i) i've been skydiving, ii) i can juggle 5 objects, iii) once met a prime minister. i'll paste my key below once i generate it. thanks!

Avery (People Ops): Welcome!! :tada: Laptop shipped — you should have an email with the MDM invite. Stickers and swag too, DM me your address and hoodie size.

Kai (DevEx): hi Sunita :wave: For SSH, either drop your public key in #infra-ssh-requests or paste it here and tag @Ravi. If you need the command: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sunita@redwood.com" && cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub```

Ravi (Infra): noted — @Sunita Rao once you paste the key i'll add you to the jumpbox ACLs. Our jump host is jump.platform.redwood (port 2222).

Sunita Rao: thanks! pasted the key in #infra-ssh-requests just now. Also, small TT: i'm allergic to most houseplants (sad but true) so if anyone keeps ferns/philodendrons near the desk please wave me over :grimacing:

Lina (Buddy): welcome! i'll keep the leafy tables at bay. also i'll add you to the team lunch thread — lots of salad options if you prefer. about the two-truths-one-lie — guessing juggling is the lie? :thinking_face:

Sunita Rao: reveal time — juggling is the lie. i've actually skydived and i did meet a prime minister once at a volunteer event. thanks for the quick help, @Ravi — my key shows as `ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeKeyExample sunita@personal` in the channel.

Ravi (Infra): got the key, provisioning now. should be ready in ~5m — i'll reply when you can ssh.

MDM-Bot: Enrollment email sent to sunita@redwood.com. Please complete device enrollment within 24 hours to avoid delays.

Kai (DevEx): pro tip: add the docker images folder to Spotlight privacy to cut index CPU, and if you want a split keyboard @Erin in #hw-recs sometimes loans a Planck.

Avery (People Ops): one more thing — swag: hoodie size? reply here and we'll ship with your laptop.

Sunita Rao: hoodie M. thanks everyone — excited to be here. happy to grab coffee later if anyone's free :coffee:

Lina (Buddy): noon works for a quick coffee catch-up? :calendar:

Sunita Rao: noon works great, thanks!
